appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Selected High-Growth Quarters: Ad Spend vs Sales'. Plot area is a scatter plot with a white background and black axes.
Five blue circular markers form a clear upward diagonal line. Q2 is at the bottom-left, Q3 is mid-left, Q4 is center, Q5 is upper-right, and Q6 is top-right.
Black text labels 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5', and 'Q6' are placed just above their respective blue dots.
Y-axis line runs from 50 at the bottom to 170 at the top, with tick marks every 10 units.
X-axis line runs from 25 on the left to 75 on the right, with tick marks every 5 units.
